title: Can Predicted Dynamics Exist in the Physical World?
abstract: arXiv:2606.00089v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can learned state-action proposals exist in the physical world? To filter infeasible commands before execution, policies are often wrapped in a runtime monitor. However, aggregating diverse diagnostic signals obscures whether a proposal violates dynamic transitions or merely departs from recorded behavior. We formalize this prediction-control interface and prove that the all-pairs displacement term is redundant within a max-aggregated composite. We evaluate these monitors on 700 nominal and 5,250 synthetically perturbed 32-transition PushT windows, monitoring only planar pusher positions and goals. A simple transition-RMSE baseline (AUC 0.982) outperforms a heterogeneous max-aggregated monitor (AUC 0.957). We conclude that physical transition checks must be strictly separated from empirical logs.

translated_title: 预测动力学能否存在于物理世界中？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.00089v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：学习到的状态-动作提议能否存在于物理世界中？为了在执行前过滤不可行的命令，策略通常被包裹在运行时监控器中。然而，聚合多样化的诊断信号会模糊提议是否违反动态转换或仅仅是偏离记录行为。我们形式化了这一预测-控制接口，并证明了在最大聚合复合中，全对位移项是冗余的。我们在700个标称和5,250个合成扰动的32步转换PushT窗口上评估这些监控器，仅监控平面推杆位置和目标。一个简单的转换RMSE基线（AUC 0.982）优于异构最大聚合监控器（AUC 0.957）。我们得出结论，物理转换检查必须与经验日志严格分离。
tldr: 本文证明物理转换检查应独立于经验日志，且简单转换RMSE基线在预测可行性监控中优于复杂聚合方法。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that physical transition checks must be separated from empirical logs, and a simple transition-RMSE baseline outperforms complex aggregated monitors in predicting feasibility.
